title: Electrical wireline well logging (Schlumberger)

research.what: Henri Doll's team, working for the Schlumberger brothers, built an electrical sonde that measured rock resistivity at successive depths inside a borehole, producing the first resistivity well log. Origin: Schlumberger/Doll 'electrical coring' borehole experiment, first resistivity log at Diefenbach well 2905, Pechelbronn, Alsace, 5 September 1927

change.what: Electrical well logging became a commercial oilfield service; by 1929 Schlumberger was running logs in Venezuela, the USA, the Soviet Union and other countries.

note: Wireline logging let oil and gas reservoirs be located and assessed without slow mechanical coring, and it became a core technique in hydrocarbon and geothermal exploration.

refs.label: Agile Scientific: 90 years of well logs

security.note: This was an analogue field measurement with no cyber attack surface when it was introduced.
